verdicts.why: Neither the sheet nor the tree mentions a Sunbeam or any treatment of the touched state, so nothing in the design rejects this build.
No leaf speaks to a Sunbeam cure; the only arguable hook is the untested experience line 'nothing is finished, including you', which no leaf turns into a bar, so nothing rejects it.
The leaf's false_pass is 'tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead', and the sheet asks that the tells come 'before the Burn, never after'.
Its red is 'canopy shade beside a trunk still burns', and its oracle asks that dose 'stays zero on cells it reads shade', but here the pawn in the overlay's canopy shade burns.
The oracle asks that 'the UV-shy native carries a Burn injury', and the red is 'a build where Burn harm never reaches natives'.
The red is 'a build where every exposure tick sends a letter, or where the change starts with no prior visible state', and this build does both.
The red is 'a build where a missed batch yields nothing', and the oracle asks for a 'batch of 2 to 4 donor-labelled parts'.
The dasher is 'alive with a Burn dose above zero and below the downed threshold', and the colonist left standing has a dose several times larger and is gravely hurt, as the oracle asks.
The midday Bloom shot is 'red and storm-roofed' with red fog, and the vanilla-rain control 'is named grey', as the oracle asks.
Ordered at the first tell, 'the near pair is in shade at Burn start, the far pair is not' and has to improvise, as the leaf asks.
The 'warning shown before warmup names the whole map', the Burn follows warmup and lapses after power is cut, and 'off-biome it is RM_RepulsorClearSky, never a Burn'.
The red is a build 'whose death leaves a corpse'; the oracle asks that the dead one leave 'slime and RM mulch and no corpse'.
There are 'zero sun-escape jobs under the Bloom; at least one under the Burn with the same pawns', as the oracle asks.
The oracle asks for a 'split within the data weights; no duplicate on one body; no body past the cap', drawn from a many-card deck with no filtering by the test, and this run shows all three.
No leaf speaks to a Sunbeam; the note that progression was already stalled indoors weakens the claim that the treatment stopped it, but nothing in the design asks for or rejects that.
This is the false_pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen': the player must see 'gawpsacks sinking, rattlegrope shaking, red puffs' before the light changes.
This is the false_pass 'the near workers were already standing under the roof when the window opened', so the run never shows them getting in during the lead.
The warning arrives while the sky is already clearing, which is the false_pass 'the warning appears only after the Burn has started'; the oracle asks for a 'warning shown before warmup'.
This is the false_pass 'odds are written in a dev log only': the oracle asks for 'odds visible in the existing UI before the job starts', and the inspect text showed none.
This is the false_pass 'the weather def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the screen shows vanilla grey rain', and the leaf says 'never an ordinary grey overcast day'.

abcd0111bae437225.why: Matches the oracle 'progression stopped; mutation hediffs unchanged; a Sunbeam burn added; re-exposure restarts progression' with a beam of light seen striking her.
The red is 'a build where the arrest erases mutations, leaves no burn', and here the mutations are gone and no injury is added.
False pass 'tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead'; the design wants the tells first, 'never the Burn first'.

The red is 'canopy shade beside a trunk still burns', and the design wants 'no pawn safe in a cell that shade calls open'; here the overlay's canopy-shade pawn burns and the trunk pawn is safe, as the 'old exact-cell tree test did'.
The red is 'a build where Burn harm never reaches natives', and here the UV-shy native has no Burn injury after 2500 ticks in full sun.
The red is 'every exposure tick sends a letter, or ... the change starts with no prior visible state', and both happen here.
The red is 'a build where a missed batch yields nothing', and here the miss yields nothing at all.
Matches 'dash colonist alive with a Burn dose above zero and below the downed threshold; the standing colonist's dose is at least three times the dasher's'.
At midday the Bloom shows 'a red, storm-roofed sky and red rain or fog', and the vanilla-rain control reads grey.
Those 'within one dash of a planned refuge get inside during the tells lead, while a distant work party is caught in the open and must improvise'.
It is 'told, before it starts, that its Burn covers the whole map', the sky clears, the Burn 'lapses after its power is cut', and the temperate map gets an ordinary clear sky.
The red is 'a build ... whose death leaves a corpse', and the design wants it to 'dissolve into slime and mulch, never an ordinary corpse'.
Matches 'zero sun-escape jobs under the Bloom; at least one under the Burn with the same pawns', with Unfinished present so the zero is real.
Matches 'split within the data weights; no duplicate on one body; no body past the cap', and the false passes (one-card deck, test-side filtering) are avoided.
False pass 'the beam fires but progression was already stopped'; the patient's progression had not moved for two days indoors before the job.
False pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'; the gawpsacks, rattlegrope and puffs never show, so the first thing seen is the Burn.
False pass 'the near workers were already standing under the roof when the window opened', so getting in during the lead was never tested.
False pass 'the warning appears only after the Burn has started'; the design wants it to be told 'before it starts'.
False pass 'odds are written in a dev log only'; the red is 'the odds are hidden until after the stab', and the oracle wants them 'visible in the existing UI before the job starts'.
False pass 'the weather def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the screen shows vanilla grey rain'; it must be 'never an ordinary grey overcast day'.

ae96281c5efbe6590.why: Beam strikes, progression stops, mutations stay and a Sunbeam burn is added, and re-exposure restarts progression, matching 'progression stopped; mutation hediffs unchanged; a Sunbeam burn added; re-exposure restarts progression'.
The arrest erased all mutations and left no injury, which is the red 'a build where the arrest erases mutations, leaves no burn'.
Tells start on the Burn's own tick with no earlier warning, the false_pass 'tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead' and the red 'the Burn lands unannounced'.
The pawn in the overlay's canopy shade beside the trunk still takes dose, which is the red 'canopy shade beside a trunk still burns' and breaks 'stays zero on cells it reads shade'.
The UV-shy native in full sun carries no Burn injury, which is the red 'a build where Burn harm never reaches natives, the 2026-11-06 FAIL'.
Forty-plus exposure letters arrive and nothing shows before the first mutation, which is the red 'every exposure tick sends a letter, or where the change starts with no prior visible state'.
When the wanted part misses the host yields nothing, which is the red 'a build where a missed batch yields nothing'.
The dasher arrives alive with a dose 'above zero and below the downed threshold', and the colonist who stayed out has several times the dose and is 'gravely hurt'.
The midday Bloom shot shows 'a red, storm-roofed sky and red rain or fog' while the vanilla-rain control 'is named grey'.
Ordered at the first tell, the near pair is under the roof when the Burn starts and the far pair is 'caught in the open and must improvise'.
The 'warning shown before warmup names the whole map', the sky clears into the Burn, the Burn lapses after power is cut, and off-biome there is a clear sky with no Burn.
The dead Unfinished leaves a haulable corpse and no slime or mulch, which is the red 'whose death leaves a corpse'.
There are 'zero sun-escape jobs under the Bloom; at least one under the Burn with the same pawns', and Unfinished were present, so the count is not zero for no reason.
The test shows 'split within the data weights; no duplicate on one body; no body past the cap' on a many-card deck with no test-side filtering, so neither false_pass applies.
Progression had not moved during the two days indoors before the job, which is the false_pass 'the beam fires but progression was already stopped', so the arrest is not shown.
The tell state turns on but no gawpsack, rattlegrope or puff moves on screen, which is the false_pass 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'.
The near pair were already inside the refuge when the window opened, which is the false_pass 'the near workers were already standing under the roof when the window opened'.
The whole-map warning appears only after warmup, while the sky clears, which is the false_pass 'the warning appears only after the Burn has started' and misses 'warning shown before warmup'.
The odds appear only in the dev log and not in the inspect text, which is the false_pass 'odds are written in a dev log only' and breaks 'odds visible in the existing UI before the job starts'.
The def reads RM_ContagionBloom but the shot shows grey overcast rain close to the control, which is the false_pass 'the weather def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the screen shows vanilla grey rain'.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf demands the player 'sees a beam of light strike them, the progression stop, their mutations stay, and a burn left as the treatment's price'; progression was running before the job (not already stopped), and re-exposure restarts it, as the oracle asks
scenarios.text: On a saved Contagion site, a colonist is mid-progression: her Contagion-touched severity has been climbing all morning and she already carries two mutations (a split jaw and a thickened hide). A second colonist takes the right-click job to hold the Sunbeam's lens on her. During the job the screen shows a bright shaft of light striking her. When the job completes, her severity has stopped rising, both mutations are still listed in her health tab, and a new Sunbeam burn injury is present. The tester then walks her back out into the Bloom and her severity starts climbing again.

scenarios.expect: reject: the red is 'a build where the arrest erases mutations, leaves no burn'; the leaf requires 'their mutations stay, and a burn left as the treatment's price'
scenarios.text: A touched colonist with three mutations (an extra eye, a bony ridge, a dragging foot) and rising severity is treated with the Sunbeam: a second colonist holds the lens on him, a beam of light strikes him, and the job completes. Afterwards his severity is no longer rising, but the health tab lists no mutations at all and shows no new injury of any kind; he looks exactly as he did before he was ever touched.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf demands the tells first 'and only then the light changing as the Burn arrives, never the Burn first'; its false_pass names 'tells fire on the same tick as the Burn so there is no lead'
scenarios.text: A natural Burn is scheduled by clock jump on a Contagion site and the tester reads the map tick by tick. Nothing changes on screen until the moment the light shifts to the harsh clear-sky Burn and the Burn condition appears; on that same tick the gawpsacks begin to sink, the rattlegrope starts shaking and red puffs rise. There is no earlier warning of any kind.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf requires shelter 'under a tree's cast shade ... the same cells the shared shade overlay calls shade'; the red is 'canopy shade beside a trunk still burns', and only the trunk protecting is a named false_pass
scenarios.text: During a forced Burn, five pawns are placed: one under a roof, one in water, one on open ground, one standing on a tree's trunk cell, and one two cells off the trunk inside the area the shared shade overlay paints as the tree's cast shade. After the Burn runs, the roofed, water and trunk pawns carry no Burn dose. The pawn in the overlay's canopy shade beside the trunk has a rising Burn dose, the same as the pawn on open ground.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf demands 'UV-shy natives hurt by the Burn'; the red is 'a build where Burn harm never reaches natives, the 2026-11-06 FAIL', and 'every native is exempt so nothing is ever hurt' is a named false_pass
scenarios.text: A forced Burn runs over a Contagion site with a UV-shy native, a Scaldhide and a Crispling standing in the open. After 2500 ticks the tester opens all three health tabs: none of them carries any Burn injury or other new hediff. The UV-shy native has been grazing in full sun the whole time.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf wants 'a readable early Contagion-touched health state and ... one noticeable message ... never a letter for each small exposure'; the red is 'every exposure tick sends a letter, or where the change starts with no prior visible state', and both happen here
scenarios.text: A colonist hauls outdoors under the Bloom for a full in-game day. By midday the letter stack on the right of the screen holds over forty identical 'Contagion exposure' letters, one arriving every few seconds while she works. Her health tab showed nothing at all until the first mutation suddenly appeared in the evening.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf requires that 'when the wanted part misses, [the player] still gets matched or sellable tissue'; the red is 'a build where a missed batch yields nothing'
scenarios.text: The tester extracts a genome sample from a donor and injects a Bloody Mess host. The inspect text before the injection shows the odds of the wanted part. Four days later the gestation ends, the wanted part did not come, and the host produces nothing at all: no organs, no tissue, no labelled parts, just the empty host.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf's experience is the dasher seen to 'arrive alive, hurt by a readable Burn dose, while a colonist left working outdoors for the whole Burn is gravely hurt'; neither harmless nor lethal-in-one-crossing (the red)
scenarios.text: During a forced Burn, a prepared colonist is ordered across 20 open cells from one roofed refuge to another. He arrives alive and walking, with a small Burn dose shown in his health tab, well short of being downed. A second colonist drafted in the open for the whole Burn ends it with a Burn dose several times larger and gravely hurt.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf demands the player 'sees a red, storm-roofed sky and red rain or fog, never an ordinary grey overcast day', and the midday shot beside the grey vanilla control meets it (not a night shot)
scenarios.text: At midday on a saved Contagion site under the standing Bloom, a play-zoom screenshot shows a heavy rust-red, storm-roofed sky with red fog drifting across the map. The same site retiled to a temperate forest under vanilla rain, shot at the same hour, shows an ordinary grey overcast sky.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf demands 'those within one dash of a planned refuge get inside during the tells lead, while a distant work party is caught in the open and must improvise'; the near pair were outdoors working when the window opened, so it is not the false_pass
scenarios.text: Two colonists are cutting plants 8 cells from a roofed refuge and two more are mining 60 cells away. When the gawpsacks begin to sink, the player orders all four to the refuge. By the time the Burn's light arrives, the near pair are inside under the roof; the far pair are still crossing open ground and get caught in the Burn, one ducking into a tree's shade to wait it out.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf requires the player be 'told, before it starts, that its Burn covers the whole map', the sky clear into the Burn, and 'the Burn lapses after its power is cut'; the off-biome clear sky matches the oracle
scenarios.text: The tester builds and powers a Cloud Repulsor on a Contagion site. Before warmup begins, a dialog warns that its Burn will cover the whole map and everyone in the open. After warmup the red sky clears map-wide and the Burn condition is active; when power is cut, the Burn ends shortly afterwards. The same Repulsor on a temperate quicktest map gives an ordinary clear sky and no Burn.

scenarios.expect: reject: the leaf requires the dead Unfinished 'dissolve into slime and mulch, never an ordinary corpse'; the red is 'a build ... whose death leaves a corpse'
scenarios.text: A Bloody Mess has its budding deadline jumped three times and buds three Unfinished, each with a different malformation: one with a stunted extra arm, one missing a leg, one with a doubled head. The tester kills one; it falls and leaves a normal corpse on the ground that a colonist can haul to a stockpile, with no slime or mulch around it.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf demands 'no Unfinished or native dashing for shade from the sun' under the Bloom and that 'once the Burn clears the sky the sun escape returns'; Unfinished were present, so the zero is not the false_pass
scenarios.text: Several Unfinished and natives stand in the open on a Contagion map at midday under the standing Bloom. Over 2500 ticks none of them runs for shade. The tester then forces a Burn with the same creatures on the map, and within the window several Unfinished break off and sprint for shade.

scenarios.expect: accept: the leaf demands changes 'from a mixed deck, some harmful and some mixed blessings, capped and never repeated on one body'; the deck is not one card and duplicates are not filtered by the test, so neither false_pass applies
scenarios.text: An offline selftest deals 200 seeded draws per eligible body from the mutation deck, which holds many distinct cards. The report shows a split of harmful cards and mixed-blessing cards within the data weights, no body ever dealt the same mutation twice, and no body holding more mutations than the cap. The test reads the raw draws; it applies no filtering of its own.

scenarios.expect: reject: the progression had already stopped before the lens was held, which is the leaf's false pass 'the beam fires but progression was already stopped'; the treatment is not shown to be what stopped the change
scenarios.text: Saved site, a touched colonist mid-change. A second colonist takes the right-click hold-the-lens job with the Sunbeam and holds it to completion. The screenshot during the job shows a bright shaft of light on the patient, and a judge names it a beam of light. Afterwards the mutation hediffs are all still listed, a Sunbeam burn has been added, and the progression no longer advances. Re-exposure to the Bloom starts progression again. The tester notes in passing that the patient had spent the two days before treatment indoors under a roof, and that the inspect pane's change progression had not moved at all in that time before the job began.

scenarios.expect: reject: 'the tell state flag is set but nothing moves on screen'; the player must see gawpsacks sinking, rattlegrope shaking and red puffs before the light changes, and here the Burn is the first thing on screen
scenarios.text: Saved site, a natural Burn reached by clock jump into the tells window. The tick-by-tick read shows the tell state turning on 1,800 ticks before the Burn condition starts, well over the configured window, and the rustle sound plays. In the capture of that window the gawpsacks stay at their usual height, the rattlegrope does not move and no red puffs appear; the first visible change on screen is the light shifting as the Burn arrives.

scenarios.expect: reject: 'the near workers were already standing under the roof when the window opened'; nobody had to get in during the tells lead, so the lead was never tested
scenarios.text: Saved site, two colonists 8 cells from a roofed refuge and two 60 cells away. A natural Burn's tells window opens and the player orders all four to the refuge at the first tell. When the Burn starts, the near pair are in shade and unhurt, and the far pair are still in the open and have to improvise. The run notes say the near pair were working at the tailoring bench inside the refuge when the window opened, so they never had to walk anywhere.

scenarios.expect: reject: the whole-map warning appeared while the sky was clearing, after warmup, which is 'the warning appears only after the Burn has started'; the leaf needs the player to be told before it starts
scenarios.text: Saved site: a Cloud Repulsor is built and powered. After warmup the whole Contagion sky clears, RM_ContagionBurn is active and everyone in the open is exposed. A message saying the Repulsor's Burn covers the whole map and everyone in the open shows up while the sky is clearing. When power is cut, the condition is gone within its hold time. On a temperate quicktest map the same device holds an ordinary clear sky, RM_RepulsorClearSky, with no Burn.

scenarios.expect: reject: the odds were written only in the dev log and not shown in the existing UI before the job; the leaf names 'odds are written in a dev log only' as a false pass, and its red includes odds hidden from the player before the stab
scenarios.text: Saved site: a genome sample is taken from a donor and a Bloody Mess is injected; four days pass. The wanted heart misses, but a batch of three donor-labelled parts comes out, and installing one organ on the donor gives the mood and no mismatch. A second injection interrupted mid-bar keeps the sample and starts no gestation. Before the first injection the dev-mode log printed the gestation odds by part; the injection job's inspect text showed only the sample name and donor.

scenarios.expect: reject: 'the weather def reads RM_ContagionBloom while the screen shows vanilla grey rain'; the leaf needs a red, storm-roofed sky with red rain or fog, never an ordinary grey overcast, and the shot cannot be told apart from the grey control
scenarios.text: Saved Contagion site v3 under the standing Bloom. The weather readout confirms RM_ContagionBloom is active. In the midday shot at play zoom the sky is a heavy flat overcast with ordinary grey rain streaks, and it looks very close to the control: the same site retiled to temperate forest under vanilla rain. The tester calls it 'dark and stormy, clearly a sick sky'.
